verdict.rationale: Working Copy keeps repositories on the device, can link external Files folders, and syncs only to remotes the user picks, including private GitHub Enterprise/GitLab/Gitea instances, self-hosted Linux/BSD/Synology servers, or AWS CodeCommit. That gives the user effective control over where code is stored. However, the AI features send staged diffs to OpenAI with no documented region or residency choice. missing for 10: region/residency control for AI-processed data, an explicit data-residency or data-location policy, independent corroboration.
